_guide.title: OmnishPilot campaign plan (days.json)
_guide.philosophy: One entry per campaign day. This replaces the whole plan for a workspace — every day you want on the board must be listed.

fieldNotes.day: Positive integer, unique across the plan. Determines schedule (campaign day N).
fieldNotes.title: Short episode title shown on the board and in the video.
fieldNotes.duration_target: Free text, e.g. "44s · 4 beats" — a target for the render, not enforced.
fieldNotes.vo_script: Full voiceover script. Leave blank for the agent to draft.
fieldNotes.social_post: Ready-to-post social copy. Leave blank for the agent to draft.
fieldNotes.image_prompt: Thumbnail image brief. Leave blank for the agent to draft.
fieldNotes.cta: Call to action shown at the end, e.g. "yourapp.com/signup".
fieldNotes.beats: Array of { caption, icon, animation } scene beats — the on-screen scene list.
fieldNotes.creative: Optional freeform object with any extra creative direction (visual_lens, palette, hero_icons, etc.) — passed through as-is.

_guide.docs: Import with "Full campaign plan" in the Import jobs modal, or edit day-by-day in the Compose tab.
